observation: Fresh main verifies durable image, budget, receipt and lifecycle integrity, but durable change paths are still weaker at ordinary read than at apply. A persisted document can carry non-canonical, escaping, blocked, credential-like, duplicate or overlapping paths and be returned by get() even though the existing apply path rejects the same path reality before side effects.
changes: Add verifiedChangePaths using the existing apply path normalization/safety/duplicate/overlap predicates.
Invoke the shared path verifier from verifiedDurableChangeset before returning a document.
Do not add live-workspace ancestor/target checks to ordinary read because those are current-workspace conflict checks rather than durable path invariants.

verification.bounded_path_replay: 6/6 PASS for safe, non-canonical dot path, parent escape, blocked segment, duplicate and overlap cases.
verification.regression_test_added: tests/changeset-read-path-safety.test.mjs exercises durable get() against the real ChangesetStore.
verification.hosted_runtime: Developer Execution Runtime remains transiently unavailable with HTTP 502; no hosted/full-suite success is claimed.

truth_boundary: This cycle moves only durable path syntax and static safety invariants to the read truth boundary. Live workspace ancestor/identity conflicts, independent provenance/authentication and broader filesystem identity semantics remain separate boundaries.
